assessments.reasoning: Section 5 constructs a graph from resolved references among declarations and makes a cycle a shader-creation error. A later module declaration can still be the resolution target.

challenge.method: Compute cycles in a two-node mutual-reference graph, a self-reference and a one-way forward-reference graph. Apply resolution before building edges.
challenge.results: Mutual and self references contain a cycle. A one-way resolved forward reference to a module declaration does not. A nearer local binding can prevent a same-spelled token from creating a module-level edge.

limitations: Only genuinely resolved references in definitions of module-scope declarations contribute. The result does not require any specific compiler diagnostic wording.
